import geopandas as gpd
import numpy as np

gdf_zip = gpd.read_file("tests/nyc_zip.geojson")

gdf_zip = gdf_zip.set_crs(4326)

gdf_zip['value'] = np.random.randint(low=0, high=100, size=len(gdf_zip))

gdf_zip = gdf_zip[["geometry", "value"]]

gdf_zip = gdf_zip.to_crs(3395)

gdf_zip.metadata = {
    'name': 'zip'
}

return gdf_zip
